threads.body: This package CHANGELOG.md explicitly states it is managed by towncrier and should not be edited directly. CI enforces this (see .github/workflows/changelog.yml, which fails PRs that modify **/CHANGELOG.md), so this new 1.1b1 section will cause the changelog gate to fail. Please revert direct edits to CHANGELOG.md and add/keep a towncrier fragment under .changelog/ instead (or apply the "release" / "Skip Changelog" label if this PR is intentionally exempt).
